WITH tei_calc AS (

    acct_gate,

  FROM security_sessions
),
tei_with_quartile AS (
  SELECT 
    tei_value,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tei_value) as quartile
  FROM tei_calc
)
SELECT

    WHEN 1 THEN 'Low Risk'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Moderate Risk'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'High Risk'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Very High Risk'
  END as danger_zone,
  COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM tei_with_quartile
